title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 125.5653155: bulk-synchronous transport, delivery charged as executed dlv, unrolled routing and grouping loops, backward pass without the R spill

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: the Chen-Stein method on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps and the enumerated inline-carry sites of the kernels (section 3.4) are charged failure rows, while RNDR, the ideal coin source, adds none (section 6). On every run its total work is at most 2^125.5653155 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Machine (section 2.1): 2^72 nodes, each with one processor and a memory below 2^64 bytes, whose links deliver a message's four words at the address its sender stored and keep no flags, rings or counters. Beyond its sender's instructions, every message's charge includes 8 instruction-equivalents at each hop: its delivery as route.s dlv (three LDPs of the message, two STPs at the address, RET: 6), which the experiment executes for every message of its 4 x 4 run, and its port's in-flight count (2). Hop 1, hop 2 and grouping are charged 20.5, 20.25 and 23.5 per record, the unrolled loops' control included; certificate.py gives at most 455.6583 instructions per leaf and the claim 125.5653155. Peak memory at most 2^135.9988 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^111.0354 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks that the work, memory and preprocessing figures are the least 7- or 4-decimal values at or above their exact values, and that 0.390000001 is below the success bound. The bound is for the machine of section 2.1. Lineage: package 8f733826 (field rows, fe_inv, class row, a64.py); no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points, and the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine, against exact references; check the arithmetic sites of section 3.4; compare the counts of the leaf, inversion, transport, delivery and grouping kernels with certificate.py; run the q25 toy and certificate.py. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
